basics.name: Lea (Mei Ling) Yeh
basics.label: Data Engineer | Data Platform | ETL at Scale
basics.summary: Data Engineer with PB-scale ETL and data-quality depth: built MediaTek's first data-warehouse layer with Airflow/NiFi/Dataflow/BigQuery on GCP, cutting missing-data rates from 50% to under 1%. Azure Databricks certified.

work.name: c-sense GmbH
work.summary: c-sense develops nanoscale sensor technology and AFM/SPM instruments for scientific and industrial applications.
highlights: Architected a modular, layered software framework for SPM instrument control, applying interface contracts and SOLID principles for long-term extensibility
Built automated measurement workflows that turn high-volume sensor measurement protocols into reliable, reproducible data-acquisition processes

work.name: MediaTek
work.summary: Devoted to data-related initiatives spanning cost control and chip development in the AI & Big Data department of a leading global semiconductor company.
highlights: Deployed model-monitoring infrastructure (MLflow + Streamlit) to track production model performance and consistency, extending data-quality practices from pipelines to ML systems

work.name: MediaTek
work.summary: Built data infrastructure and analytics platforms for one of the world's largest IC design companies.
highlights: Designed PB-scale ETL pipelines on GCP (Airflow, NiFi, Dataflow, BigQuery) for structured and unstructured data, processing distributed datasets across the company's data platform
Architected the company's first data-warehouse layer, introducing dimensional-modeling theory that improved data-table reuse during the company's early digital transformation
Built real-time data-quality monitoring and alerting that cut missing-data rates from 50% to under 1% and saved 7.5 man-days per month
Tracked ML model performance and data drift in production via MLflow and Grafana dashboards, bridging data engineering and DataOps/MLOps
Managed EDA license and computing-farm costs via interactive BI dashboards (Splunk + Grafana), informing procurement decisions and reducing costs by 25%

projects.name: Inception-of-Things — K3s Kubernetes Cluster

Configured Kubernetes ingress, service routing, and workload deployment across cluster nodes
Applied GitOps principles with ArgoCD for continuous deployment in the bonus track
